title: Elf Bar 600 Banana Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Compatible with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods offer a seamless way to enjoy outstanding flavour and satisfaction without the waste and expense caused by single-use disposables. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on personal usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth and satisfying draw with rapid nicotine relief. Banana Ice Flavour: A rich and creamy banana flavour with a smooth, mellow sweetness, followed by a crisp menthol finish that adds a refreshing coolness to every inhale. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—just click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're switching from disposables or looking for a reliable, flavour-packed alternative, these prefilled pods ensure the same great performance that Elf Bar is known for.
